# Muse-Desktop

Curated by Skill Harbor: Muse-Desktop is the desktop app Muse Code was missing. Meta's coding agent ships as a CLI; this Tauri/React harness wraps it with projects grouped by folder, git worktrees, subagents with their own lane, MCP servers (local or remote, remote tokens kept in the system keychain), a diff review panel, and a live view of thinking, tool calls and answers in Markdown. Its headline feature is opt-in computer use: with your explicit permission, Muse can observe your screen or drive your applications through the open-source cua driver. By @EtienneLescot, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: you need a Muse Code account (authentication and model choice come from the engine, not the app); computer use starts Off and you pick the level, but it is still an agent controlling your screen, so review what you grant; the Windows installer is not code-signed yet (expect an unknown-publisher warning; installs per-user, no administrator rights); macOS is Apple Silicon only and Linux is not started. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
